reviews.review:
Gearbox mostly unf**ked it! (after really f**king it!)

Good on them for working with members of the community when they could have easily written it off.
Multiplayer will always disconnect near the end of a match for some reason.  Tried swapping hosts between friends, nothing works.
Risk of rain? More like risk of no ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥

#Chris_doesn't_miss
On a serious note, this game is fantastic, the pinnacle of indie rogue-like game (was indie)
everything about it is (or was) done with passion and care way back since 2016. The visual artstyle, gameplay, and lore, all made by a team who really wanted to make something timeless.
Now times have changed and this game has gone through controversial events, such as hopoo games (the og devs) giving this game's IP to gearbox which means the game isn't in the hands of it's original makers who haven't poured the same love and care for it. the recent updates were mixed, it took a long time for them to fix things that the og devs would never do and this game is in no way perfect as it had problems since launch

There's obviously a lot of issues
>My biggest gripe with it is that there is NO ITEM SHARING IN MULTIPLAYER WHICH IS A PROBLEM, this makes multiplayer harder/worse for players as if the team isn't thinking strategically every moment they pick up an item, they are going to die, straight up, they will not survive late game unless you play on baby mode, there are many mods that fix this issue and this makes many people never want to play this game vanilla,
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>Unlocking abilities ranges from very simple to frustrating, recent and old characters' requirement for unlocking abilities are so hard that many players just opt to cheat them in, the false son for example as the worst requirement, it requires you to be lucky on 3 darn factors, and kill the final boss in the most risky way possible and you get 1 chance for these 3 factors + final boss.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>Locking characters from the previous game behind dlc is scummy, it's even worse when the characters are ruined like the chef, even though the chef is fixed it took a long time to do such a simple change that shouldn't even done in the first place if they just copied the character correctly, and locking OP characters behind dlcs makes the game pay to win,characters should be more balanced to not make dlcs pay 2 win or scams.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
>This game is missing a lot of QoL features such as showcasing the player's stats, multiplayer drop in, item descriptions before pickup and much more, this makes the game sorta out-dated as it's missing a lot of modern features from games today, making our beloved a bit indie-game outdated.

Despite the problems this game has/had, it's still amazing and worth the pickup, if you are playing it alone, wait for sale, if you're playing wtih friends definatly worth full price, buy the dlcs later on or when on sale, and definitely try out mods such as Starstorm 2, literally one of the best mods in gaming history it expands the game a lot and makes it vanilla friendly since the first game.
Rating: 
7.5/10 single player.
8.5/10 multiplayer.
